title: Shri Nivas v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shashi Kant Gupta, J.; Neeraj Tiwari, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; delayed objections to be heard; s.127 reserved.
headnote: On a missed-deadline challenge to a final electricity assessment, the Court did not quash the assessment. Taking a lenient view, it directed the consumer to appear before the Executive Engineer with a belated objection, a speaking final order within four weeks, and a short stay of coercive recovery, leaving any remaining grievance to a Section 127 appeal.
facts: Shri Nivas filed a writ against a final assessment dated 27 July 2019 issued by the Executive Engineer (respondent no. 2), seeking to quash it and a mandamus to let him file a belated objection. He said unusual circumstances had prevented a timely objection, and that the department was taking coercive recovery without a further hearing or following the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for the electricity department was heard. The High Court did not try the assessment on merits.

holding_units.topic: relegation to s.127 after delayed-objection hearing
holding_units.holding: The Court did not quash the 27 July 2019 final assessment or decide Supply Code compliance. Taking a lenient view of the missed objection deadline, it directed the petitioner to appear before the Executive Engineer on 17 December 2019 with his objection and evidence; the officer was to pass a speaking final order within four weeks; and coercive action was stayed for seven weeks or until that disposal, with automatic revival of the recovery citation on default. Any remaining grievance after that final order was left to an appeal under Section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003.

principle_tags.application: On a missed-deadline challenge to a final electricity assessment, the Court did not quash the assessment..

not_decided.point: Validity and quantum of the 27 July 2019 final assessment
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the assessment on merits.

not_decided.point: Compliance with the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Non-compliance was alleged but not decided.
